@phoneKitReady.description: Home status pill: the wallet is connected and up to date. One short word.

@phoneKitReconnecting.description: Home status pill: the wallet is trying to reach the network again. One short word.

@phoneKitAvailable.description: Label on the bar above the keypad on an amount screen; the amount the wallet can spend follows it.

@phoneKitLeaves.description: Line under the amount while sending: what stays in the wallet after the network fee. {amount} is like '7.49 EPIC', {fee} is like '0.008 EPIC'.

@phoneKitBack.description: Screen reader label of the back arrow in a flow header.

@phoneKitDeleteDigit.description: Screen reader label of the backspace key on the keypad.

@phoneKitPinDigits.description: Screen reader label of the PIN dots: how many digits are entered so far. Numbers only, never the digits.

@phoneKitSwapCurrency.description: Screen reader label of the button that swaps the amount between EPIC and the fiat currency.

@phoneKitStepDone.description: Screen reader label added to a finished step in a list of steps.

@phoneKitStepNow.description: Screen reader label added to the current step in a list of steps.

@phoneKitStepLater.description: Screen reader label added to an upcoming step in a list of steps.

@phoneKitPickerSaveFailed.description: Line in a picker sheet when saving the tapped choice failed; the sheet stays open.
